# Observed BigQuery rejections, recorded with tools/bqanswers.
# GoogleSQL's reference implementation accepts these forms, but BigQuery's PIVOT rewriter
# rejects HAVING modifiers and null-respecting ARRAY_AGG (even when no NULL reaches it).
# The null-handling restriction is also documented in
# ../../../../../third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax.md.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(p) FROM (
  SELECT 'a' AS k, 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 'b', 9 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', 2
) PIVOT(MAX(v HAVING MAX v) FOR k IN ('a', 'b', 'missing')) AS p
=> error contains: Use of HAVING inside an aggregate function used as a PIVOT expression is not supported

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(p) FROM (
  SELECT CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS k, 1 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 'b', 2
) PIVOT(ARRAY_AGG(v) FOR k IN (NULL AS n, 'b', 'missing')) AS p
=> error contains: Use of aggregate function ARRAY_AGG as PIVOT expression is not supported unless IGNORE NULLS is specified

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(p) FROM (
  SELECT 'a' AS k, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS v UNION ALL SELECT 'b', 2
) PIVOT(ARRAY_AGG(v) FOR k IN ('b')) AS p
=> error contains: Use of aggregate function ARRAY_AGG as PIVOT expression is not supported unless IGNORE NULLS is specified

# HAVING is rejected for COUNT(*) too, including with a NULL HAVING value.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(p) FROM (
  SELECT 'a' AS k, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS v UNION ALL SELECT 'b', 2
) PIVOT(COUNT(* HAVING MIN v) FOR k IN ('a', 'b', 'missing')) AS p
=> error contains: Use of HAVING inside an aggregate function used as a PIVOT expression is not supported
